note.text: Homophones share pronunciation while differing in meaning; their spellings may differ, as with hear and here. Homographs share spelling but differ in meaning and may differ in pronunciation, as with lead a group and lead the metal. Homonym has both a broad dictionary use and a narrower school use for words sharing spelling and pronunciation with different meanings. This lesson states the narrower use when needed. Categories can overlap, so do not force one exclusive label where the question has not specified its criterion.

sections.heading: Your goal and connections
sections.text: By the end, you should be able to distinguish sound, spelling and meaning while recognising that terminology can overlap. Builds on: context clues, word classes and written sound symbols. Leads to: editing narrative vocabulary and avoiding wrong-word spellings.

sections.heading: Read the original model
sections.text: Original set: Hear the speaker here. A bat can be an animal or sports equipment in the narrow homonym model. Lead a group differs from lead the metal in the pronunciation model. Spell-check alone may not detect a word that is spelled correctly but has the wrong meaning for the sentence.

sections.heading: Apply and check
sections.text: Ask whether the exercise compares sound, spelling or both. Read the context to identify meaning. The screen can compare written examples and transcriptions, but actual pronunciation needs a teacher or recording. Confirm the school’s preferred homonym terminology.

example: Homophones must have identical meanings. Correction: The shared sound does not make their meanings identical.
Homographs must always have the same pronunciation. Correction: The relation is based on spelling; pronunciation can differ.
The word homonym has only one definition in every source. Correction: Dictionaries and courses can use broad or narrow definitions; state the convention.
A correct spelling guarantees the right word for the context. Correction: A word can be spelled correctly but express the wrong meaning.
